dogecoin.text: The creator of Dogecoin below. You may disagree, but it's worth noting his criticisms.

Did you know? Dogecoin is merge mined with Litecoin. Back in 2014 it was deemed that Dogecoin couldn't get enough hashrate to be secure, and both Dogecoin and Litecoin were 51% attack risks to each other. The only real difference between Doge and Litecoin is the decimal point.

A number of older coins too.
